मोदः [मुद्-घञ्]
1 Delight,
pleasure, joy, gladness; यत्रानंदाश्च मोदाश्च

मोदक a. (का, --की f.) [मोदयति
मुद्णिच् ण्वुल्]
1 Pleasing, delighting,
gladdening.
--2 Glad, delighted.
--कः,
--कं A sweetmeat in general;

.
--कः N. of a mixed tribe
(sprung from a Kṣatriya father and
a Śūdra mother).
--Comp.
--कारः a
confectioner.

मोदनं [मुद्-ल्युट्]
1 Joy, pleasure.
--2 The act of pleasing.
--3 Wax.

मोदयंतिका, मोदयंती A kind of
jasmine (Arabian).

मोदयंतिका, मोदयंती A kind of
jasmine (Arabian).

मोदित a. Glad, pleased,
delighted.
--तं Pleasure, delight.

मोदिन् a. [मुद्-णिनि]
1 Glad,
pleased, cheerful.
--2 Gladdening,
delighting.
--नी
1 N. of various
plants (अजमोदा, मल्लिका, यूथिका).
--2
Musk.
--3 An intoxicating or
spirituous liquor.
